title: iPhone held by fix-hero-exit-threaded, unused for 5 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
fix-hero-exit-threaded has held the iPhone lease for 5 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 15:14Z, lease taken by fix-hero-exit-threaded). The limit is 5 min.
Queued for it: iphone-runner.
fix-hero-exit-threaded: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner fix-hero-exit-threaded) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits. Desk (mgmt-desk-2): please make sure the phone is used.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).
